verdict.rationale: Vercel documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.vercel.com that uses OAuth and Streamable HTTP, with one-command setup and a broad tool inventory covering projects, deployments, logs, analytics, agent runs and domains. A live probe confirms the server is up and OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec, and Vercel's onboarding playbook and llms.txt direct agents to connect it. Missing for 10: connections are limited to an allowlist of Vercel-approved AI clients, so arbitrary or custom agents may not connect, and there are no independent community reports of real-world use.
